title: mentha × verticillata f. pilosa
intro: Mentha × verticillata f. pilosa, commonly known as American pennyroyal or American brooklime, is a plant species belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, including aiding digestion, relieving stress and anxiety, and exhibiting anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Mentha × verticillata f. pilosa include acting as a carminative, antispasmodic, and expectorant, making it a natural remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonene, menthone, and beta-pinene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
